Interface ValidateConnectionResult

All Known Implementing Classes:
ValidateConnectionResponseJson
public interface ValidateConnectionResult
A single connection specification returned by the Fabric connection validation API (POST /fabric/v4/connections/validate). Describes a connection that would be (or already is) provisioned for the supplied authorization key or VLAN, allowing callers to verify availability before creating a connection.

ianjones
